problem.title: Existence of a dense cubic Gaussian-moment failure in three variables
problem.scope: Determine whether a complex total-degree-three polynomial P in three independent real Gaussian coordinates has all positive pure moments zero but admits a fixed polynomial Q with E(QP^m) nonzero for infinitely many m. The complete sixteen-coefficient W-linear cubic family is GMC-safe by G3WLINEAR20261114, with sufficient888 pure gate and sharp3*deg-Q mixed cutoff; earlier scoped charts, finite bounds and the old UNKNOWN six-variable computation retain their meaning. A Gaussian W-linear frame exists exactly when a nonzero v satisfies B(v,v)=0, grad F3(v)=0 and F2(v)=0. GSMOOTHFINITE20261114 now excludes every smooth leading plane cubic: some pure moment among the first188 is nonzero. It gives an all-N,D>=3 smooth-leading formula and a ternary first-five-zero, sixth-nonzero example;188 is sufficient only on this locus. G3COERCIVE20261114 additionally excludes cubics with a complex linear gradient lower bound, including all-nodal leading curves when F2 is nonzero at every node. Thus any global failure has singular F3 and the isotropic-singular/F2-zero projective intersection empty. If its leading curve has only ordinary nodes, there must be at least one F2-zero node and every such node must be nonisotropic. G3PRODUCT20261114 now closes every homogeneous completely reducible cubic, with sharp pure gate8 and sharp deg-Q mixed cutoff; independent-factor homogeneous triangles cannot be pure-null. Its exact seven-zero/eighth-nonzero triangle remains sharp within that subclass. G3REDUCIBLE20261114 now closes every homogeneous reducible ternary cubic, including nonsplit line-conic forms: optimal pure gate10 and sharp mixed cutoff deg Q. Pure-null reducible cubics are exactly those admitting P=(l^T*x)*(x^T*A*x), l^T*l=0 and A*l proportional to l. Tangent line-smooth-conic products have sharp pure gate8, while every transverse line-smooth-conic product has a nonzero pure moment by10, sharply; the tenth-order sharpness has a length28 algebraic realization certificate. A joint quadratic Gaussian generating identity and exact rational Bezout identities prove the full class. G3CUSP10_20261114 now excludes every homogeneous irreducible cuspidal ternary cubic: some positive pure moment by10 is nonzero, with sharp bound10 on this entire class. The explicit cusp P=Z^2*T+W^3 has its first nine pure moments zero, tenth1508855040000, and M_(10r)=binomial(10r,6r)*(12r)!*(6r-1)!! for all r>=1, with all other positive moments zero. Thus any arbitrary-ternary-cubic initial pure gate is at least10; no explicit global upper bound is established. G3NODALREDUCTION20261114 completes the affine critical-locus partition for an F2-zero nonisotropic node via P=T*H+G and H=uv+h: finite conic/axis critical points, explicit product exceptions, and the separately retained center critical line. It gives an exact conic period chart but no zero-action decay theorem; Gaussian width can cancel1/t, and the omitted chart must be controlled. G3REPLICAGAP20261114 prevents using correlated-replica reconstruction as though its data followed from pure vanishing. G3HOMOGENEOUS20261114 now closes every homogeneous ternary cubic: all irreducible nodal forms have a nonzero pure moment, by the affine Newton/V-filtration argument for nonisotropic nodes and the retained conic exclusion for isotropic nodes. Combined with smooth/cuspidal/reducible results, all homogeneous pure-null forms are exactly those admitting the isotropic-eigenvector factorization P=(l^T*x)*(x^T*A*x), l^T*l=0 and A*l proportional to l. Every such form has the sharp mixed cutoff m>deg Q. No explicit uniform nodal or all-homogeneous numerical pure gate is asserted. The general nonhomogeneous nodal, cuspidal-leading, reducible-leading and other unresolved singular-leading cases remain open. All homogeneous ternary cubics are removed from the unresolved GMC queue. The cuspidal pure-nonvanishing proof uses exhaustive semi-invariant covariance charts and exact rational determinant-power memberships, rather than a frame assumption or a modular lift. No theorem forces a W-linear frame from pure moment vanishing for arbitrary cubics; all homogeneous pure-null cubics are now classified. The period proofs remain internal written arguments with exact algebra checks, no external review or formalization. Neither888 nor188 is asserted to cover arbitrary cubics. Earlier scoped supporting exclusions remain G3AFFINEW20261114, G3AFFINEWCUBIC20261114, G3SHEARCUTOFF20261114, G3AFFINEWFINITE20261114, G3HEIGHT20261114, G3HEIGHTFINITE20261114, G3LINEARWT20261114, G3MIXEDPHASE20261114, G3MIXEDSPINE20261114, G3MIXEDCONTROL20261114, G3MIXEDFULL20261114, G3MIXEDFINITE20261114, GWNONSING20261114, G3WZTFINITE20261114, G3WTRANKONE20261114. G3NODALCRITICAL20261114 now locates all Gaussian-phase critical branches for irreducible nodal leading form with nonisotropic node and F2(v)=0. Its affine normal form P=T*(uv+h)+a*u^3+d*v^3+b*u^2+c*v^2+e*u+f*v+k, a*d!=0, retains the entire transformed Gaussian metric and means, with m=Q_TT!=0. The phase tP-Q has affine critical length7 for every t!=0. The finite-critical profiles have finite Milnor sums6,4,3,2 and exactly1,3,4,5 escaping Morse branches, with T scales t,t^(1/3),t^(1/4),t^(1/5). All escape actions have a nonzero positive-power term; the fractional actions retain the common k*t. The h=e=f=0 center-line boundary has no escaping phase-critical points, with possible axis limits (m*T+l_T)*(T^2-4bc)=0. Exact Gaussian completion proves stable width Phi_ss->1/m on the compact conic chart. These are algebraic/local-width results: no uniform global sectorial splitting, center-line decay or new nonhomogeneous GMC exclusion is proved. G3NODALCENTER20261114 now proves normalized critical-cut period decay for the entire h=e=f=0 irreducible nodal center-line family, retaining the full affine Gaussian mean and metric. Its uniform complex gradient estimate for tP-Q confines all vanishing-cycle carriers to radius squared<=A+B*s with constants independent of t. Compatible semialgebraic cut-pair triviality, uniform area bounds and Federer-Fleming compactness force fixed-band limits into complex P-fibers, where the holomorphic top volume vanishes; the tails are uniformly small. This excludes all members whose critical values k,k+4*b^3/(27*a^2),k+4*c^3/(27*d^2) lie in a closed half-plane through0. In particular the entire zero-critical-line class k=0 is pure-nonvanishing, for arbitrary b,c and Gaussian means. Affine translates of homogeneous irreducible nodal forms are included. The subsequent G3NODALCENTERALL20261114 closes the entire center-line class, including strict critical-value triangles. G3NODALMORSE20261114 excludes the finite-critical Morse/distinct-value locus, with the stated quartic gamma!=0 condition. Only degenerate affine critical points, coincident affine P-values or the quartic gamma=0 resonance remain as possible irreducible nodal-leading exceptions. No numerical pure prefix or general nonhomogeneous cubic theorem is asserted. G3NODALCENTERALL20261114 uses a separating ray where the two off-axis rank1 Morse periods have distinct positive exponential growth and all five critical-line periods decay. Their nonzero scalar Gaussian leading terms force both growing coefficients to vanish, so no nonzero constant period remains. Thus any irreducible nodal-leading pure-null candidate has a finite affine critical set. G3NODALMORSE20261114 promotes pointwise coercivity of tP-Q to polynomial-in-parameter carriers by semialgebraic selection; logarithmic cutoffs give actual full-cut Morse asymptotics for all seven branches. Distinct finite critical values and, on the quartic escape profile, gamma=d*e*m/(2*c)-l_T!=0 make the positive actions distinct. Successive dominance then excludes the full specified open locus. Degenerate or coincident-value loci and the swapped quartic resonance are explicitly retained, without extrapolation by continuity or a general formal-block assertion. Neither theorem gives an explicit numerical pure prefix. Subsequent G3NODALRESONANCE20261114 excludes the quartic gamma=0 resonance on the finite Morse/distinct-P-value locus whenever Xi=-4*D*c^4+4*b*c^3*d*m+2*c^3*l_v+c^2*d+d^3*e^2*m!=0, with D=Q_uT and l_v the linear v coefficient of Q. After a variable swap use the corresponding coefficients. The first normalized scalar amplitude coefficient is chi=e*Xi/(2*K*c^3), opposite for opposite K; sum/difference periods have nonzero orders r^5/r^6 after their common exponential, r=t^-1/4. Grouped successive dominance then excludes a nonzero constant period despite the shared positive action. Thus on this Morse/distinct-value quartic chart any remaining pure-null candidate must satisfy BOTH gamma=0 and Xi=0. A retained nondegenerate Gaussian example meets both conditions, so that exact boundary remains unresolved rather than inferred closed by continuity. Other nodal degeneracies/value collisions, other singular-leading nonhomogeneous cubics, global numerical gates, coefficient schemes and lower-power GVC remain open. Current refinement G3NODALALL20261114 closes EVERY irreducible nodal-leading ternary cubic with arbitrary lower terms and the full affine Gaussian. The earlier finite degeneracy, coincident-value and simultaneous gamma=Xi=0 boundaries are all closed by a full formal rank7 frame, not further scalar amplitude nonvanishing conditions. Every finite isolated critical point has exact local type alpha+s*w+y^(mu+1), with noninteger characters1+j/(mu+1). The1/3/4/5 escaping Morse branches have nonzero exponential factors. Weighted polynomial confluent interpolation proves completeness, and symmetric escape-product descent identifies the zero-exponential component over the base Laurent field; it has no trivial regular factor. All pure zeros would provide a rational trivial quotient of the differential seed submodule, contradicting the absence of that composition factor in the full module. The retained complete critical-line theorem supplies the nonisolated case. Thus the remaining arbitrary-cubic leading-curve frontier is NONHOMOGENEOUS CUSPIDAL OR REDUCIBLE (including repeated-line degenerations), while smooth-leading and every homogeneous ternary cubic are already safe. General cubic GMC remains open. No explicit global numerical upper pure gate, independent replay, external review or formal verification is obtained; coefficient schemes and lower-power GVC remain separate. Current further refinement G3CUSPALL20261114 closes EVERY irreducible cuspidal-leading ternary cubic for GMC, with arbitrary lower terms. If F2(cusp)!=0, a direct cusp gradient argument gives complex linear coercivity and pure-nonvanishing. If the cusp is isotropic and F2(cusp)=0, the retained W-linear Gaussian frame theorem supplies GMC safety. If the cusp is nonisotropic and F2(cusp)=0, keep the full affine Q with m=Q_TT!=0 and reduce to P=T*(u^2+gamma*v+h)+v^3+buv+eu+fv+k. The phase S_t has affine/twisted rank6 and projective infinity length2. The smooth parabola, separated lines and five double-line profiles give complete formal rank6 frames; finite A_mu characters, escaping Gaussian hierarchies and fixed quartic/cubic blocks exhaust all dimensions. After ramification the formal module is semisimple; all nonzero exponential factors have no map to the trivial module, while every zero-exponential scalar seed value has strictly positive parameter valuation. A trivial rational seed quotient from all pure zeros would extend to the full formal module and take a positive-valuation seed value to1, impossible. Thus every nonisotropic cusp member is pure-nonvanishing, with degenerate and positive-dimensional critical loci retained. The isotropic case is asserted GMC-safe via the earlier theorem, not separately pure-nonvanishing by this result. Consequently the CURRENT remaining possible cubic GMC failure has a NONHOMOGENEOUS REDUCIBLE leading curve, including repeated-line degenerations. General cubic GMC remains open; no explicit global numerical upper pure gate, external review, independent replay or formal verification is claimed. Coefficient schemes and lower-power GVC remain separate. Current refinement G3TRIANGLEAFFINE20261114 pure-excludes EVERY ternary cubic whose leading form is a product of three linearly independent linear forms, with arbitrary lower terms. Isotropic zero-F2 ordinary nodes fall in the nondegenerate W-conic exclusion; all-nonzero-F2 nodes are coercive. Remaining affine triangle charts P=T*(uv+h)+b*u^2+c*v^2+eu+fv+k retain full Q, m!=0, and A!=0 if b=0, B!=0 if c=0. Their generic Gaussian phase rank is5, with three simple infinity nodes. All32 support patterns split into23 finite critical patterns,5 critical-conic patterns and4 critical-axis patterns. Finite A_mu characters and explicit1/3/4 escapes exhaust5, and an unnormalized confluent partial-fraction numerator basis proves the complete frame across different escape scales. Critical conics have fixed Laurent rank4 with positive t^-1 seed valuation plus one Morse/escape dimension. Critical axes have a uniform complex gradient bound for tP-Q, actions kt+O(1), and rank5 normalized cut/current-limit decay. Thus coincident values, equal actions, conic degeneracies, arbitrary constants and Gaussian means are included. This extends the centered three-factor theorem to independent leading factors with all affine perturbations, without asserting the same for concurrent factors. The CURRENT remaining possible cubic GMC failure has a NONHOMOGENEOUS LINE-SMOOTH-CONIC leading curve, THREE CONCURRENT distinct leading lines, or a REPEATED leading line. General cubic GMC remains open, with no explicit global numerical upper pure gate; coefficient schemes, lower-power GVC and external review remain separate. Current refinement G3CONCURRENT20261114 closes EVERY ternary cubic with three distinct CONCURRENT leading lines for GMC, with arbitrary lower terms. If F2(vertex)!=0 a direct gradient argument gives pure exclusion; isotropic zero-F2 vertices use the retained W-linear safe classification. At a nonisotropic zero-F2 vertex, retain Q_TT=m!=0 and full Q. Exact Gaussian completion gives binary cubic phase tG-q2+(tH-J)^2/(2m) of full rank4, with nondegenerate Schur Gaussian for constant H. Fixed binary critical points have A_mu or exact homogeneous rank4 types and complete formal frames. For nonconstant H=u, distinguish the leading-factor flag. If u does not divide F3, finite critical rank2 combines with escape rank2; its degenerate A2 escape is exhausted by ord A=1,2 shrinking Gaussian charts or ord A>=3 fixed cubic rank2, retaining a nonzero quartic leading action. If u divides F3, a primary quartic-action escape combines with finite1+secondary2, secondary3, or a fixed quartic critical-parabola block of rank3. All zero-exponential seed powers are positive; complete semisimple formal frames exclude a rational trivial seed quotient. Thus every nonisotropic-vertex concurrent-line cubic is pure-nonvanishing. Isotropic zero-F2 safety is asserted via the earlier W-linear theorem rather than a separate pure exclusion. The CURRENT remaining possible ternary cubic GMC failure has a NONHOMOGENEOUS LINE-SMOOTH-CONIC leading curve or a REPEATED leading line; independent and concurrent distinct-line triples are both closed. General cubic GMC remains open, no numerical global upper pure prefix is obtained, and coefficient schemes, lower-power GVC, external review and formalization remain separate. Current G3LINECONIC20261114 closes EVERY line-smooth-conic leading ternary cubic for GMC, with arbitrary lower terms. All transverse members are pure-nonvanishing: the rank6 affine nodal normal form has26 finite support patterns,2 fixed Laurent hyperbola patterns and4 uniform critical-axis patterns, including every finite multiplicity and resonance. Tangent members with F2 at the tangency nonzero are gradient-coercive; isotropic zero-F2 tangencies use W-linear safety. The remaining nonisotropic tangent form P=T*(u^2+g*v+h)+(u+c)*v^2+eu+fv+k has full rank5;11 complete profiles cover Gaussian escapes, critical parabolas/lines, quartic fixed blocks and a final D5/Gaussian block with positive t^-3/4 seed. G3REDUCEDLEADING20261114 therefore closes EVERY SQUAREFREE leading ternary cubic for GMC. Any pure-null member in that locus has a nonzero isotropic singular direction v with F2(v)=0, admits a Gaussian W-linear frame and has sufficient mixed cutoff m>3*deg Q; sharpness of3 on the reduced locus is not claimed. The CURRENT possible cubic GMC failure has NONREDUCED leading form L^2*M or L^3 ONLY. General cubic GMC remains open on those repeated-line affine classes; no numerical global upper pure gate is obtained, and coefficient schemes, lower-power GVC and external review remain separate.
